subject: Nimbus Health — SOC 2 re-attest timeline and retention term discussion
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-01-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 recert + retention requirement for renewal

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the renewal heads-up. As we prepare Nimbus's renewal (targeting end of Feb), a few items from security/legal that we need to surface early: 

- Updated SOC 2 report (recert) or interim attestation for the 2027 period.
- Audit log retention: current contract lists 12 months; Nimbus security team is requesting 13 months for clinical audit purposes.
- Evidence transfer window: can you provide a bulk transfer path for full syslog/trace bundles (S3 presigned or secure SCP)?

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to meet the 13-month retention and provide an approximate timeline for sending the SOC 2 materials? Also looping procurement for contract/term discussion.

Thanks —
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Security Operations
Nimbus Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-01-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + retention requirement for renewal

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the early flag and context. Short answers up front: we can support a 13-month audit-log retention as an add-on, and we expect to have the SOC 2 recert package ready to share by Feb 10. Details below and an attachment with the SOC2 summary.

What we'll deliver:
- SOC 2 recert summary (PDF) and SOC auditor contact details — see attached (SOC2-Summary-2027.pdf).
- Secure evidence transfer options: S3 presigned link or encrypted SFTP; we typically stage evidence to a time-limited S3 bucket for handoff.
- Retention change: our standard hosted contract includes 12 months; a 13-month retention can be done as a one-time pricing addon (we'll provide line-item).

Timeline
- By Feb 3: internal readiness check and packaging of logs/evidence.
- By Feb 10: SOC 2 summary + auditor letter + proposed evidence transfer instructions.
- Week of Feb 13–17: bulk handoff window (mutually scheduled).

To make the retention change smooth, can procurement confirm whether Nimbus prefers a contract amendment for a 24-month term (helps amortize the retention cost) or a 12-month renewal with one-off addon? If you loop legal, we can draft a short amendment for signature.

Attaching SOC2-Summary-2027.pdf (attached: stub).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-15T08:31:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus SOC2 recert + retention requirement — pricing / terms prep (internal)

Karthik / Vanessa —

Forwarding Nimbus ask. Quick notes for a pricing proposal we can send to procurement:
- 13-month retention as a retention addon: $1,250 flat per month (one-time pro-rated adjustment for the remainder of the renewal year) OR discounted if they take 24-month term.
- If they want bulk transfer (we offer S3 presigned + audit manifest): include professional services prep fee $2,000 for evidence bundling and manifest generation.
- They are also interested in a modest capacity uplift for peak month traffic: propose a 20% dedicated burst pool for Q1 as a temporary uplift ($3,500/mo) or a committed seat increase.

Recommend we propose two commercial paths in the amendment: (A) 12-month renewal + retention addon + one-off transfer fee; (B) 24-month term with retention baked in at 25% discount on retention addon and reduced one-time transfer fee.

I can draft the amendment and pricing spreadsheet; Vanessa can you sanity-check the scope and channel any legal language changes?

-M

From: procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nimbushealth.com>, Jordan R. <jordan.r@knotlegal.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus SOC2 recert + retention requirement for renewal

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick responses. A few asks from procurement/legal before we proceed: 

1) Can you provide a short amendment that:
   - extends the retention to 13 months,
   - sets the term to 24 months (we're leaning that way),
   - lists the one-time transfer process and SLA for delivery of evidence.

2) Please include a redline-ready DPA update if the retention change triggers any data processing differences.

3) We'd like the pricing spreadsheet and a DocuSign-ready amendment so our legal can turn quickly.

If you can get a proposed amendment + pricing by EOD Monday (Jan 22), we'll aim to route to legal for review and return by Thurs.

-Julia (procurement, Nimbus)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-21T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus SOC2 recert + retention requirement for renewal — proposed amendment

Julia / Sarah —

Please find attached the proposed commercial amendment and pricing worksheet (retention-addon-pricing.xlsx). Key points: 

- Term: 24 months (start date aligned with renewal anniversary).
- Retention: 13 months for audit logs; pricing shown as one annualized line-item and discounted to 25% if committed to 24 months.
- Evidence handoff: Redwood will stage logs to a time-limited S3 bucket; we will provide manifest + SHA256 checksums. Transfer SLA: package availability within 5 business days of request; handoff window scheduling to be agreed.
- Professional services: $1,500 one-time for packaging (discounted from list price).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC-12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7839201

If that looks good I can send the DocuSign amendment and update the HubSpot deal to reflect the 24-month term + retention addon and capacity uplift option.

Attaching retention-addon-pricing.xlsx (attachment stub).

Best,
Marissa

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-01-25T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus SOC2 recert + retention requirement for renewal — proposed amendment

Marissa —

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. I will share with legal and procurement today. Two quick clarifications before routing: 

1) Please confirm the S3 presigned URL will be valid for a minimum of 14 days once issued.
2) Confirm that the manifest will include per-file SHA256 and a brief readme documenting the log types included.

If you confirm those two items we will route for signature and aim to return signed DocuSign by end of next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sarah
